provenance.note: Place name on the river, geocoded to the reach [supplied on this invocation]
Steady upstream CARRIER discharge - the river flow that dilutes and transports the release [supplied on this invocation]
Result-writing cadence; unset keeps the steering file's own period [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]
Point-source discharge of the release itself, small against the river's carrier flow [supplied on this invocation]

Which preset was spilled: light_crude | diesel | heavy_fuel - the module's own composition, density and viscosity. Crude runs as light_crude, gasoline and petrol as diesel, bunker as heavy_fuel [supplied on this invocation]
Concentration of the DISSOLVED fraction released with the slick, carried as the reach's tracer [supplied on this invocation]
Modeled reach length downstream of the release; a longer reach is coarsened under the mesh node budget [supplied on this invocation]
Simulated physical time [supplied on this invocation]
How many floating particles the module tracks; the slick is drawn from their positions, so a coarse count draws a coarse slick [supplied on this invocation]
The solver step the floats are released at, compiled into the module's own release routine; it lets the flow field establish before the slick is put on it [supplied on this invocation]
Target element edge length the reach is triangulated at; where the slick reaches is a front location and moves with the elements that carry it [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class [declared constant default]
Along-reach release position, 0=upstream..1=downstream; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the reach, never on a boundary [declared scenario default]
Sustained wind driving a surface wind-stress term; 0 = no wind [declared scenario default]
Compass bearing the wind blows FROM (0=N, 90=E); only read when wind_speed_mps > 0 [declared scenario default]
How often the particle positions are written; it converts to a count of solver steps at the run's own timestep [declared scenario default]
not supplied; the reach flowline is fetched fresh for the AOI
not supplied; the carrier discharge is read at the MOST RECENT published NWM cycle
not supplied; the reach is solved at Strickler 33.0, which is also the roughness its outflow stage is derived as a normal depth at
not supplied; the coefficient is read as a Strickler one
not supplied; the release sits at spill_fraction along the meshed reach; the downstream distance is measured from there
